hooks.text: Four interacting galaxies share the sky with a supersonic impostor.
A famous galaxy group hides an interloper crashing through at supersonic speeds.
One galaxy in Stephan's Quintet sits 200 million light-years closer than the others.

title: The Supersonic Impostor in Stephan's Quintet
description: Stephan's Quintet looks like a peaceful cosmic family, but one galaxy is actually an interloper plowing through at supersonic speeds.

beats.text: Four interacting galaxies share the sky with a supersonic impostor.
beats.visual: Hubble Space Telescope mosaic of Stephan's Quintet, 2009

beats.text: Discovered in 1877 by Édouard Stephan, the group in the constellation Pegasus appears to be a tight cluster of five.
beats.visual: Pegasus constellation map showing Stephan's Quintet location

beats.text: However, modern measurements revealed that its brightest member, NGC 7320, is merely a foreground interloper.
beats.visual: James Webb Space Telescope NIRCam image of Stephan's Quintet, 2022
queries: Stephan's Quintet James Webb Space Telescope

beats.text: It sits only thirty-nine million light-years from Earth, while the other four galaxies are parked 210 to 340 million light-years away.
beats.visual: Galaxy redshift distance diagram for Hickson Compact Group 92

beats.text: Even wilder, another intruder named NGC 7318B is currently falling into the center at supersonic speeds of several million kilometers per hour.
beats.visual: Artist concept of supersonic galactic collision and bow shock
queries: Galaxy collision shock wave artist concept

beats.text: This violent impact generates an immense cosmic shock wave bigger than the entire Milky Way.
beats.visual: Chandra X-ray Observatory composite of Stephan's Quintet shock wave, 2006

beats.text: That colossal crash proves the true quintet is still taking shape,
beats.visual: James Webb Space Telescope MIRI image of galactic shock region, 2022
queries: Stephan's Quintet James Webb Space Telescope

beats.visual: Wide composite image of Stephan's Quintet galaxies interacting, 2022

better_than_last: Replaced the pop-culture detour in beat 7 with active collision tension and used 'Where' in beat 8 to construct a seamless grammatical sentence looping directly back into beat 1.
